tasks.detail: MSVC x64 + OpenCV + Zivid SDK Debug
tasks.label: build cpp
tasks.command: call "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" >nul && cl.exe /nologo /EHsc /std:c++17 /utf-8 /Zi /Od /MDd /D_DEBUG /DUNICODE /D_UNICODE /I"D:\opencv\build\include" /I"%ZIVID_INSTALL_FOLDER%\include" "${file}" /Fe:"${fileDirname}\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe" /Fo:"${fileDirname}\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.obj" /Fd:"${fileDirname}\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.compile.pdb" /link /DEBUG /PDB:"${fileDirname}\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.pdb" /LIBPATH:"D:\opencv\build\x64\vc16\lib" /LIBPATH:"%ZIVID_INSTALL_FOLDER%\lib_debug" opencv_world480d.lib ZividCored.lib
